Step 3 Binary Multi-channel Benchmark

Input resolution fixed at 384 x 384. Binary task: CEA 0,1,2 -> class 0 and CEA 3,4 -> class 1. ResNet50 ImageNet pretrained; AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4; batch 16; 50 epochs; no validation, scheduler, or early stopping. Seeds: 42, 3407, 2026. Step 2 M (White) is the baseline and is not retrained.
